This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Peanut is at risk due to behavioral reasons. His previous owner states that he will hard bark, growl, lunge, and snap at strangers and children. While in care, Peanut has displayed similar behaviors. Noted to lunge to the front of the kennel and bare teeth when handlers attempt to handle him. Peanut's previous owner states that he is very loving. With a slow approach Peanut has been receptive to treats from the handler. Medically, Peanut is apparently healthy.

Peanut arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. His previous owner states that he will hard bark, growl, lunge, and snap at strangers and children. While in care, Peanut has been observed to be highly fearful noted to lunge to the front of the kennel and bare teeth when handlers attempt to handle home. Due to the detailed behavior we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
